research_question: Does the 2006 Economic Census establishment listing provide an independent Sumatera Barat construction-establishment population and master-sampling-frame benchmark that constrains interpretation of the annual construction-survey establishment count and its possible frame semantics?

se06_role_and_scope.important_boundary: SE06 explicitly produces population, directory, and master-sampling-frame infrastructure for economic surveys, but this does not establish that the full SE06 construction listing is the exact operational sampling frame used by the Annual Construction Survey.

annual_survey_comparator.coverage_text: The Annual Construction Survey includes national construction establishments which have construction projects in Indonesia.
annual_survey_comparator.establishment_definition_text: The annual-survey explanation defines an establishment as an economic activity unit providing goods/services in a physical building with its own cost structure and production records; documented legal forms include cooperative/partnership/government/private and related forms.

same_year_2006_comparison.comparison_scope: same geography and nominal year, but different statistical operations; count differences constrain simple equivalence mappings without identifying the exact annual-survey universe or frame

negative_identification.why_this_is_material: The annual-series count is neither the full SE06 construction listing nor either legal-status partition. Therefore legal status alone cannot explain the annual-series universe, and the annual count cannot be treated as the SE06 population or master-sampling-frame total without additional period-specific frame documentation.

mechanism_candidate_effect.new_constraint: SE06 explicitly supplies population, directory, and master-sampling-frame infrastructure, but its Sumatera Barat construction population is 4,504 in 2006, split into 1,379 legal-status and 3,125 nonlegal-status establishments. The Annual Construction Survey series reports 2,664*. Because 2,664 matches neither the full listing nor either legal-status partition, the exact annual-survey frame/universe remains unresolved.
mechanism_candidate_effect.remaining_gap: The exact inclusion rules and operational source frame behind the annual-series count, the 2005 Sumatera Barat qualification composition, old/new annual-survey frame counts, and period-specific weights remain unrecovered.

next_gate.title: Resolve the annual-survey universe/frame semantics or recover 2005 qualification composition
preferred_evidence: contemporaneous BPS documentation explicitly identifying which construction directory/frame generated the annual-survey population estimates
